name: python-aho-corasick
title: Many Patterns, One Sweep
blurb: Multi-pattern matching in one pass: a trie with BFS failure links, suffix outputs that never miss an overlap, and a hit set proven equal to a naive scan on seeded alphabets.
default_description: An Aho-Corasick automaton whose one sweep reports every pattern at every end position, equal to a naive scan and cheaper than its product.
